text: A stranger films you rescuing a cat from a bin. Two million views. The cat has an agent now.

left.label: Ask them to take it down

up.label: Launch a channel about bins

risk.result: The comments mostly want the cat.

text: A TV quiz show needs one more contestant. The host's teeth are visible from space.

up.label: Go all in on the final question

risk.result: Wrong capital. Your nan never lets it go.

text: Open mic night. The sign-up sheet has one slot left and a coffee ring where your name goes.

up.label: Do the bit about your family

risk.result: Your mum was in the third row. She did not laugh.

text: You speak at a rally for your queer neighbours' rights. A news crew points a camera at you.

up.label: Give them the speech of your life

risk.result: The trolls find your email. You find the block button.

text: The local bakery names a pie after you. It is mostly gravy, and it is selling out.

up.label: Cut a ribbon at the pie launch

risk.result: Gravy on the ribbon. Gravy on the mayor.

text: The local paper wants a profile. The photographer keeps saying 'more neighbourly'.

up.label: Bring props and a backstory

risk.result: They print your age wrong. Upward.

text: Someone at the servo says 'aren't you that person?' You are, broadly speaking, a person.

up.label: Sign their receipt with a flourish

risk.result: They thought you were someone else. They keep the receipt.

text: Community radio wants you on at 6 a.m. Their listeners are four insomniacs and a parrot.

up.label: Take over the whole morning show

risk.result: The parrot learns your catchphrase. So does everyone.

text: You're asked to ride in the town parade. The float is a giant papier-mache potato.

up.label: Stand on the potato and dance

risk.result: The potato was not load-bearing.

text: A local influencer says you copied their whole thing. Their thing is wearing a hat.

up.label: Challenge them to a hat-off

risk.result: You lose the hat-off. It's on the news.

text: The council asks you to front the charity fun run. You last ran in primary school.

up.label: Run it in a mascot suit

risk.result: Heatstroke in a foam koala. Very on brand.

text: A street artist paints you on the side of the laundromat. Your nose is a bit generous.

left.label: Ask them to fix the nose

up.label: Hold an unveiling party

risk.result: You catered. Nobody told you the laundromat has no fridge.

text: A big podcast wants you on. The host interrupts guests for a living, and for fun.

up.label: Interrupt the host first

risk.result: The clip goes round as 'rude guest'. Downloads double.

text: An agent with a ponytail calls. 'Babe, I see you as a brand.' You see him as a ponytail.

up.label: Sign, but read every line

risk.result: Page 40: he owns your middle name.

text: A publisher offers you a book deal. You are not sure you've lived enough to fill a page.

up.label: Promise them a tell-all

risk.result: Your family asks what 'all' means.

text: A yoghurt brand wants you in an ad. You are lactose intolerant and, sadly, very cheap.

up.label: Write the ad yourself

risk.result: Fourteen takes. Fourteen spoonfuls. A long night.

text: You hit 100,000 followers. One of them comments 'mum' on every post. It is not your mum.

up.label: Livestream a party for them

risk.result: 'Mum' turns up to the livestream. In person. Somehow.

text: You're nominated for a small award. The trophy is shaped like a deeply confused swan.

up.label: Write a speech in case

risk.result: You lose. The speech is still in your hand on every photo.

text: Your ex gives an interview about you. The headline is 'Ex Reveals: Leaves Dishes'.

right.label: Post a photo of clean dishes

up.label: Joke about it on a talk show

risk.result: Your ex was watching. Round two.

text: A drag queen does you at a club night. She does you better than you have ever done you.

up.label: Join her on stage for a duet

risk.result: She gets the standing ovation. Fair.

text: A fancy restaurant gives you a table without a booking. The people waiting give you a look.

up.label: Pay for the whole queue's dinner

risk.result: The queue was longer than it looked.

text: A photographer has been living in your hedge. He has started paying rent to the hedge.

up.label: Stage a fake scandal for him

risk.result: The fake scandal is somehow worse than a real one.

text: A late-night host wants you on. The other guest is a dog that can count to four.

up.label: Upstage the dog

risk.result: Nobody upstages the dog. The internet sides with the dog.

text: A fan has your face tattooed on their calf. It's a good likeness, except for the moustache.

up.label: Pay for a matching one of them

risk.result: Tattoo of a stranger on your calf. Committed.

text: A party asks you to stand for parliament. You have never once voted before lunch.

up.label: Run on a platform of free libraries

risk.result: You lose by twelve votes. Your mum forgot to vote.

text: Fan letters arrive daily. One writer knows what you had for breakfast. You had toast.

up.label: Hire proper security

risk.result: Security eats more toast than you do.

text: A charity wants you as an ambassador. They help homeless trans youth find safe homes.

up.label: Match every donation for a year

risk.result: Your fans are very generous. Your bank is less thrilled.

text: Rumour says someone will play you in a film. Your shortlist is two actors and your cousin.

up.label: Audition to play yourself

risk.result: You don't get the part. Of you.

text: You're on a magazine cover. They airbrushed out your elbows. All of your elbows.

up.label: Demand they print the real you

risk.result: Elbow discourse dominates the week.

text: Your agent says famous people fly private. The planet says otherwise, and quite loudly.

up.label: Take the train and film it

risk.result: Fourteen hours. The dining car runs out of sandwiches.

text: A mansion with a moat is for sale. The moat has its own swan with a criminal record.

up.label: Rent it for one wild party

risk.result: The swan wins. Photos go everywhere.

text: An old joke of yours trends. It punched down at gay people and it has aged like milk.

up.label: Apologise, donate, and do the work

risk.result: Some people stay angry. That's fair. You keep going.

text: A wax museum unveils your figure. It looks exactly like you after a very long flu.

up.label: Swap places with it for an hour

risk.result: A child touches your face. You flinch. The child screams.

text: Your book is out. The tour has twenty cities and one very, very tired highlighter.

up.label: Read the spicy chapter aloud

risk.result: Chapter nine names names. The names are upset.

text: A gala invite. The theme is 'sustainable couture'. Your outfit is mostly salad. Some croutons.

up.label: Wear the salad

risk.result: A goat at the after-party has notes.

text: A ghostwriter offers to run your socials. You have never been funnier, or less yourself.

up.label: Hire them, then outwrite them

risk.result: They quit. Your fans can tell.

text: You play a stadium. Ninety thousand people. One of them is your primary school teacher.

up.label: Pull your teacher up on stage

risk.result: She tells ninety thousand people about your nits.

text: Your entourage now has an entourage. Someone's job is holding the other person's water.

up.label: Give them all a pay rise and a day off

risk.result: You have to hold your own water. Shocking.

text: A fan climbs your gate with a cake. It says 'for you, forever'. It is not a small cake.

up.label: Get them real help, gently

risk.result: They come back with a second cake.

text: They're making a film of your life. The actor playing you is taller and has better knees.

up.label: Cameo as your own dentist

risk.result: Your scene is cut. The dentist chair is kept.

text: A billionaire invites you to his private island. You google him and close the laptop fast.

up.label: Expose him with a journalist friend

risk.result: His lawyers send you a fruit basket. And a lawsuit.

text: You're asked to headline Pride. Some sponsor pulled out. Your fans are furious on your behalf.

up.label: Headline and cover the missing money

risk.result: The glitter budget alone. Worth it.

text: You have not been alone in three years. You cry in a wardrobe at an award show. It's lovely.

up.label: Vanish to a farm for a year

risk.result: A goat eats your phone. Industry forgets your name, briefly.

text: A company made an AI copy of your voice. It's selling mattresses. It is very convincing.

up.label: Win the case and change the law

risk.result: The appeal takes two years. Your voice still sells mattresses.

text: The country puts you on a stamp. People lick the back of your head every day now.

right.label: Buy a sheet for your mum

up.label: Lick the first one live on TV

risk.result: It tastes of glue and national pride.

text: Your town unveils a bronze statue of you. Pigeons have already formed an opinion.

up.label: Fund a park around it

risk.result: The fountain was extra.

text: A lifetime achievement award. You're not sure you have finished the lifetime yet.

up.label: Give the trophy to your first fan

risk.result: They cry for forty minutes. So do you.

text: Strangers name their children after you. One family named their dog. It suits the dog.

up.label: Visit every namesake you can find

risk.result: There are four thousand of them.

text: You announce a farewell tour. It's your third farewell tour. Tickets sell out anyway.

up.label: Make it free for anyone under 25

risk.result: Twelve encores a night. Your knees file a complaint.

text: Your encyclopedia page is longer than your country's. Someone edits in that you can fly.

up.label: Confirm you can fly

risk.result: A small cult forms. They're mostly polite.

text: A shy teenager asks how you got famous. The real answer is a cat in a bin, but still.

up.label: Fund their first record

risk.result: It flops. They thank you on their second one.

text: Your memoir is a film. The book was 'mostly true'. The film is 'loosely inspired by vibes'.

up.label: Narrate it yourself

risk.result: Twelve hours in a booth saying 'and then I knew'.

text: The fan who climbed your gate writes from a clinic. They are doing well and want to say sorry.

up.label: Meet them with a counsellor there

risk.result: It's awkward. Mostly good awkward.
